title: Ask HN: Are you unfollowing friends on GitHub because of AI slop?
excerpt: Last week one of my IRL friends started playing with claude code. What was a fairly nice feed on my Github landing page turned into five pages of just his commits. I like my friend and want to keep up with what he's up to, but it now drowns out all my other friends who also do great work. I may need to unfollow him.
